_how: One switch per stage for the proposed prompts in components/video-teardown/prompts/proposed/ (chain.py PROPOSED_FILES). A false switch means that stage runs its live prompt, unchanged; a true switch means it reads its proposed file. Switched on 2026-11-07 by the owner's pick: stage3 (injection), stage4i (idea), stage4v2a (hooks). Research stays off because only the mechanism stage, also off, reads it. Test runs can use VW_PROPOSED=stage4g,stage5 instead of editing this file.
